name: IndiaRestros MCP
summary: Free, keyless MCP and REST API over India's restaurant graph: places, phones, timings, cuisines and menus with rupee prices.
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP at https://indiarestros.com/mcp needs no key for reads. Eight tools: search_restaurants, get_restaurant, search_dishes, get_menu, list_places, get_place, report_correction and about_dataset. llms.txt describes about 1.7 million places across thousands of cities with permanent IRR- ids; API fields carry src and observed dates. No paid rankings or commissions. Corrections are accepted via report_correction.
